title: Upload
targetTip: Uploaded files land in the folder open in the active panel. CannonCommander asks first about files of the same name.
queueTip: Large files go up in chunks of 10 MB. If the connection breaks, the upload picks up at the last finished chunk, even after a reload of the page once you choose the file again.
keepsRunning: Keeps running when you close the window
notHere: Nothing can be uploaded into this folder
failed: {n} files could not be uploaded. Choose them again and the upload goes on from the last chunk.
